text: Operations on ST 81, OCS-G-27155, Well A-1 to restore production from the existing "O" Sand perforations, 19268' - 19358' MD were completed, but proved unsuccessful.  Coil tubing was used to pump a scale treatment into the formation, which allowed the fish located @ 19212' MD to fall downhole and re-expose the "O" Sand perfs to production.  However, the A-1 well only produced water and is currently shut-in.  Operations began on January 19, 2010 and ended on January 23, 2010.

text: Stone Energy has sucessfully isolated the J Lower sand perforations with a 59' cement cap on top of a bridge plug set at 8099'MD. The J Upper Sand was perforated for production from 8008'-8028'MD at 12 spf & 7994'-8007'MD at 6 spf. Operations were concluded prior to setting of screens & gravel packing due to pulling out of rope socket, creating the rope socket/perforation assembly fish. Operations are stopped pending evaluation for future coil tubing operations. Well is shut in.

text: Coiled tubing zone change Operations were successfully completed on the EI 28 Well #006 to produce the "Upper Cib-Carst" Sand. The "Lower Cib-Carst" Sand was isolated setting a MRBP at 10,656' MD w/ 20' of cmt dump bailed on top of the plug; ETOC at 10,636 MD. Bridge plug & cmt plug were pressure tested to 3500 psi. A peddle basket was set at 10,520' MD w/ 17' cmt dump bailed on top of basket; ETOC at 10,503' MD. The "Upper Cib-Carst" Sand was exposed to production by perforating intervals 10,478'-10,490' MD/TVD. Operations started 06/03/2013 and ended 06/14/2013.
